finalText:
Build's clean now, 0 errors.

Two real bugs were hiding under all that deprecation noise, both from the bundler bump changing shapes it hands to your code:

1. `src/core/options.js` still read `options.retries`, but the new bundler sends `retryCount`. Fixed to read the right field.
2. `src/net/retryPolicy.js` treated an unset backoff flag as invalid and threw. The new config loader leaves it `undefined` instead of `false`, so I made `undefined` mean disabled, same as before.

Everything else was just deprecation and dedupe chatter, safe to ignore.
